name: isDASTScanCurrent
definition: True when the newest successful DAST scan the product returns finished within the last 30 days.
population: every successful scan the DAST product returns to the connected API user, newest end time first
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A successful read of the successful-scan list (scan_status succeeded, sorted by end time) containing a scan with status succeeded and a readable end_time no more than 30 days old. An empty list is a fail; a list holding other statuses or unreadable end times with no recent success is not measured.

openDecisions.question: Should another DAST product (for example a different web application scanner) be allowed to answer this key, or should it stay with Burp Suite DAST until a second implementation is replayed?
positions: any (registered): every Application Security integration may answer it, held to this definition.
listed: only Burp Suite DAST until a second product's implementation is replayed against real data.

citations: safeguards/devsecops/burpsuitedast/isdastscancurrent.py (reads Integration-Service method listCompletedScans: scans(sort_column: end, sort_order: desc, scan_status: [succeeded]) { status end_time scan_target })
https://portswigger.net/burp/extensibility/dast/graphql-api/scan.html (end_time: the time at which the scan finished; retrieved 2026-11-13)
https://portswigger.net/burp/extensibility/dast/graphql-api/scanstatus.html (succeeded: the scan has finished successfully; retrieved 2026-11-13)

changeLog.change: Registered for the PortSwigger Burp Suite DAST checks. No live server read yet, so the key is proposed and V0.

notes: The 30-day bar is in the transform; daysSinceLastScan carries the number for the report.
